_comment: Follow-up verification: csharp-refactor-di showed a quality gap (Qwen 90 vs Ornith 80.7,
docs/quality-rubric.md). Two specific failure modes drove Ornith's score down there:
(1) stubbing real implementation logic behind NotImplementedException instead of
preserving it, and (2) giving a 2-line DI excerpt instead of the literally-requested
'standard Program.cs'. This config re-tests BOTH failure modes in a different domain
(bash/terminal instead of C#) to see if it's a general completeness/fidelity issue or
specific to that one C# task. Same models, same sampling as config.article.json.
Single task, 3 repeats each - fast, targeted, not a full re-run.

tasks.name: bash-script-extend
tasks.systemPrompt: You are a senior DevOps engineer. Output the complete, updated script only - no diff format, no ellipses, no '// unchanged' placeholders, no prose before or after.
tasks.prompt:
Here is deploy.sh:

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

APP_DIR="/srv/app"
BACKUP_DIR="/srv/backups"
LOG_FILE="/var/log/deploy.log"

log() {
  echo "$(date -u +'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ') $1" | tee -a "$LOG_FILE"
}

log "Starting deploy"

if [ ! -d "$APP_DIR" ]; then
  log "ERROR: $APP_DIR does not exist"
  exit 1
fi

timestamp=$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)
tar -czf "$BACKUP_DIR/app-$timestamp.tar.gz" -C "$APP_DIR" .
log "Backed up current app to $BACKUP_DIR/app-$timestamp.tar.gz"

git -C "$APP_DIR" pull origin main
log "Pulled latest from main"

systemctl restart myapp.service
log "Restarted myapp.service"

log "Deploy finished successfully"

Add a health check after the restart: curl http://localhost:8080/health up to 5 times, 2 seconds apart. If none of the 5 attempts return HTTP 200, roll back by extracting the most recently created backup in $BACKUP_DIR over $APP_DIR, restart myapp.service again, log the rollback, and exit 1. Every existing step (the log function, the directory check, the backup, the git pull, the restart, the final success log) must keep working exactly as before. Output the complete updated deploy.sh.
